positioning_summary: Alchemer is supported in this pass as a restaurant-technology vendor in: customer feedback.

latest_cos_commentary.headline: Adjacent restaurant-tech vendor; no supported direct Genius overlap.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Monitor for expansion into Genius categories and verify account-level influence before treating as a direct competitor.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Evidence quality varies materially across this long-tail batch; unresolved names remain deliberately unclassified rather than guessed.

restaurant_tech_categories.basis: Current evidence supports customer feedback as a restaurant-facing category for Alchemer.

negative_findings.value: This pass identified an adjacent restaurant-technology/service role but did not establish a current restaurant-specific product that directly overlaps a Genius product line.

strengths.value: Vendor has current restaurant-specific product evidence in the cited source(s).

vulnerabilities.value: Vendor-originated product evidence does not by itself establish ROI, reliability, implementation quality, or systemwide customer adoption; independent validation remains a research gap.

key_customers.value: Dunkin' uses Alchemer Mobile, formerly Apptentive, for in-app surveys, Love Dialog, Mobile Notes, ratings and reviews, and mobile sentiment to prioritize app changes and communicate with app customers.
key_customers.limitations_or_conflicts: The page is undated; outcome metrics and app scale are vendor-reported and lack independent validation or measurement windows.

key_customers.value: A&W Restaurants uses Alchemer, formerly Chatmeter, for listings management, review monitoring and response, local SEO, competitive measurement, and franchise-opening scorecards.
key_customers.limitations_or_conflicts: The page is undated, uses current branding for a former-Chatmeter deployment, and does not independently validate current full-estate scope or quantified outcomes.

key_customers.value: Paris Baguette uses Alchemer across more than 300 U.S. and Canadian cafes for review aggregation, surveys, listings management, sentiment analysis, competitive benchmarking, NPS/CSAT, Pulse AI, and AI Review Signals.
key_customers.limitations_or_conflicts: The page is vendor-authored, its scale and outcomes are not independently audited, and it establishes North American rather than global scope.

key_customers.value: True Food Kitchen uses Alchemer sentiment tagging and weekly feedback reporting across 45 restaurants; a negative-sentiment spike informed the seven-week reversal of a chopped-salad menu removal.
key_customers.limitations_or_conflicts: The vendor-authored source does not isolate Alchemer as the sole cause of the menu decision or disclose the full technical stack and contract term.

key_customers.value: Figaro's Pizza and Pizza Schmizza use Alchemer review analysis to identify operational and menu issues and are piloting AI-generated review responses in brand voice.
key_customers.limitations_or_conflicts: The AI response capability is a pilot, and the source does not separate deployment counts or technical scope for the two brands.

product_lineage.value: Alchemer's restaurant-facing portfolio includes capabilities formerly branded Apptentive for mobile experience and Chatmeter for listings and reputation management, alongside current products such as Pulse AI and AI Review Signals.
product_lineage.limitations_or_conflicts: The pages establish brand lineage but not migration dates, contract continuity, data migration, or adoption of every current module by legacy customers.
